study type: Secondary data analysis of a cross-sectional survey
exposure: Assistance at birth from skilled worker
cohort: 7,223 women between the ages of 15 and 49 in Benin
finding: The prevalence of early initiation of breastfeeding among mothers was 56.0%, and was lower among employed women, women who had caesarean sections, those exposed to mass media, and women who received assistance at birth from a skilled worker.
mod_finding: Women who had a cesarean section were less likely to practice early initiation of breastfeeding.
